This evidence carries substantial weight in supporting the bear case. [E2] (bear) Price-to-book is 18.78x with a price of ₹415 on a book value of ₹22.1 indicates that shareholders are not getting much for their investment, further reinforcing the bear argument. [E3] (neutral) Market capitalisation at ₹215 Cr suggests that while the company has some market presence, it is not large enough to justify such high valuations, which aligns with a bear case. [E4] (bear) Dividend yield of 0.00% indicates no immediate return for shareholders, another factor supporting the bear perspective. [E6] (bear) ROCE and ROE at 0.8% suggest poor operational efficiency, which is detrimental to investor returns and supports the bear argument. [E8] (bear) Compounded sales growth over five years of -13% indicates a significant decline in revenue, further supporting the bear case that Sancode Technologies Ltd may be facing substantial challenges. [E9] (bear) Compounded sales growth over three years of 3%, while positive, is not enough to offset the negative trend seen over longer periods and does not support the current valuation. [E10] (bull) Compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months at 37% suggests a strong recovery or potential for future growth, which contradicts the bear case based on previous years' performance. However, this evidence is limited to one period and should be considered cautiously. [E50] (bear) The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -13.2% over past five years, indicating a significant decline in revenue, which supports the bear perspective that Sancode Technologies Ltd may not be performing well. [E59] (bear) Earnings growth has decelerated, which is concerning for investors and supports the bear argument that Sancode Technologies Ltd may be facing challenges in generating profits. [E65] (bull) Sector median profit growth at 10.5% suggests a positive trend within the sector, supporting the bull case but does not necessarily apply to Sancode Technologies Ltd alone. [E66] (bull) Sector median sales growth at 14.1% indicates strong overall performance in the sector, which could support the bull argument that Sancode Technologies Ltd may be outperforming its peers.
